title: Threat, Clock, Pressure & Escalation Authoring
objective: Extend the prepared MAS Adventure workspace with deterministic Threat, Clock, Pressure and Escalation Authoring over the MAS-01..07 foundations while preserving the MAS program boundary between prepared authoring semantics and canonical/live runtime state.

scope.purpose: Represent prepared Threat, Clock, Pressure and Escalation authoring inside the MAS workspace without treating prepared authoring as live occurrence or canonical owner-state mutation.
scope.completion_gate: A representative MAS workspace can deterministically author Threat, Clock, Pressure and Escalation material over the completed MAS foundations with explicit references and fail-closed invalid states while preserving canonical/runtime authority and never treating prepared authoring as executed live truth.

selection_boundaries: MAS-01 through MAS-07 remain completed foundations and were not reopened.

Threat, Clock, Pressure and Escalation structures remain prepared authoring semantics only; CNI-08 may evaluate trigger eligibility while Action/Event and applicable runtime owner domains retain occurrence, progress, execution and mutation authority.
Clock segments are authored ordered identifiers only; MAS-08 created no scheduler, wall-clock timer, current-segment ledger or hidden trigger ledger.
Prepared threats, clocks, pressure and escalations never prove live occurrence, progress, applied pressure, callback execution or Action/Event truth.
MAS-08 consumes explicit MAS-07 cast, agenda, relationship-plan, callback and inherited prepared Adventure references; dangling references fail closed.
Existing MAS validation family remained active; no family transition occurred in MAS-08.
ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.json was reconsulted after MAS-08, including current MSLR planning; no new cross-program rotation is unlocked, so MAS-09 is selected_not_started.
CNI-12 and PCA remain unselected; MAS-10+ and SMB-08 were not implemented by this tranche.
next_action: MAS-08 is closed. MAS-09 is selected_not_started after ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH reconciliation and requires a later owner Continue before governed start.
